BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to impact fees for residential construction; addinga new section to chapter 82.02 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Impact fees for residential construction shall only be collected bythe county, city, or town imposing the impact fee either: (1) At the time of final inspection of the residence; or (2) At the time the certificate of occupancy is issued.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Impact fees under this chapter for residential construction shallonly be collected by the county, city, or town imposing the impact feeeither: (1) At the time of final inspection of the residence; or p. 1 SSB 6413 (2) At the time the certificate of occupancy is issued.
